requirement_authority.note: Exact 0058 repository values remain authoritative; rounded here only for evidence-gap comparison.

sources.citation: CRESST Collaboration, Description of CRESST-III Data, arXiv:1905.07335
sources.threshold_or_window: 30.1 eV nuclear-recoil threshold reported for released best module
sources.reason_not_comparable: Publishes selected events/acceptance region and detector data description, but does not provide a detector-wide measured low-energy topology/background rejection factor paired with a same-selection bulk-NR acceptance suitable for direct 0058 comparison.

sources.citation: CRESST Collaboration, Latest observations on the low energy excess in CRESST-III, arXiv:2207.09375
sources.reason_not_comparable: Constrains possible origins of the LEE but does not report the preregistered measured combined rejection x bulk-NR acceptance achievement pair.

sources.citation: CRESST Collaboration, Observation of a low energy nuclear recoil peak in the neutron calibration data of the CRESST-III Experiment, arXiv:2303.15315
sources.detector_environment: CRESST-III detector modules with neutron calibration
sources.reason_not_comparable: Provides a genuine low-energy NR calibration anchor but not a detector-wide underground background rejection/leakage measurement paired with the same NR acceptance.

sources.citation: SuperCDMS Collaboration, Light dark matter constraints from SuperCDMS HVeV detectors operated underground with an anticoincidence event selection, Phys. Rev. D 111, 012006
sources.reason_not_comparable: Demonstrates underground anticoincidence/pile-up improvement for an electron-scattering analysis, not a measured CEvNS-like bulk nuclear-recoil rejection x acceptance pair. Cross-section sensitivity improvement is not a background rejection factor.

sources.citation: CDMS Collaboration, Exclusion Limits on the WIMP-Nucleon Cross-Section from the First Run of the Cryogenic Dark Matter Search in the Soudan Underground Lab, arXiv:astro-ph/0507190
sources.reason_not_comparable: This is a real measured underground rejection/efficiency example, but its >10 keV regime is orders of magnitude above the 10-100 eV NMIR/CRESST low-energy regime and therefore fails the frozen comparable-window criterion.

summary: Targeted primary-source audit found genuine low-energy thresholds, NR calibration and topology/anticoincidence mechanisms, plus older high-energy measured discrimination, but no same-configuration underground sub-keV detector result with both measured background rejection/leakage and measured CEvNS-like bulk-NR acceptance suitable for direct comparison to the 0058 1.44e7-1.78e7 requirement.
